profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point, labeled Mozoilo AJVP with operator Mozoilo, is located in Galdakao, in the Basque Country region of Spain. Despite the data center style tagging in source data, this registrys research this session found no evidence connecting the name Mozoilo to any computing, colocation, or data center business anywhere. Extensive searching across English, Spanish, and Basque language sources turned up only two unrelated matches for the name Mozoilo in this area: a now inactive real estate agency called Inmobiliaria Mozoilo SL, previously registered in Galdakao, and an unrelated local Basque cultural festival and radio program called Mozoilo Eguna and Mozoilo Irratia. Neither connects in any way to data center infrastructure, and the AJVP portion of the facility name could not be matched to any known company or facility naming convention. This registry records this honestly as an unverifiable or likely mistagged point rather than fabricating a data center profile for it; it may represent a mapping error in the underlying source data, misattributing an unrelated local business or landmark as a data center facility.
